title: Mutable document collections
scope: Requests, work items, plans, dependencies, risks, decisions

claims.statement: JsonFileDocumentStore maintains an inode/size/mtime cache, overlays queued changes for reads and coalesces concurrent mutations into locked whole-file rewrites.
The writer reloads under its file lock, writes a temporary file, syncs that file and renames it into place.
A service-level list-then-put decision remains outside the collection lock. Independent services can base business decisions on separate snapshots even when individual writes serialize.

limits: The inspected shared-store PlanService test uses sequential service calls; it does not establish simultaneous uniqueness or multi-file transaction isolation.
